summary: Paul Frasch, 59, of Silverthorne, CO, was walking a trail near the 'Rapid 5 1/2 Pullover' camping area along the Arkansas River on County Road 371 in Buena Vista on June 23, 2026 when he dislodged rocks that fell on him; an estimated half-ton boulder was still on top of him when first responders arrived. He did not survive his injuries; the Chaffee County Coroner took possession and next of kin was notified.
location: Rapid 5 1/2 Pullover camping area, Arkansas River along County Road 371, Buena Vista
notes: Two moving-company workers stopped at a popular riverside camping/lunch pullout; victim dislodged rocks while walking back up the trail. Coroner's office took possession. Source: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Facebook page.
